title: Event forwarding adapters
goal: Deliver raw events through injected services with observer ordering
scopes: raw event forwarding and observer ordering
approach: Handle calls Started on a non-nil observer, delegates the raw input to the injected Transformer exactly once, calls Finished with the original result only when the error is nil, and returns the original result and error unchanged.
explicit_rules: Do not trim, uppercase, coerce, retry, recover panics, or replace values
Preserve raw input, result, and error identity
Started precedes Transform; Finished occurs only on success for a non-nil observer
constraints: Delegate raw values exactly once; do not normalize or coerce
Observer started before service; finished only on success
required_verification: Service substitution, error identity, and observer ordering tests
